stem: What is the approximate incidence of major malformations in liveborn babies?
explanation: 2-3% is the approximate incidence of major malformations in liveborn babies.
rationale: This is the baseline frequency of major congenital anomalies among live births.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because 0.5% is lower than the usual estimated incidence in liveborn babies.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because 2-3% is the approximate incidence of major malformations in liveborn babies.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 15-20% is far higher than the expected rate in liveborn babies.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 10% is higher than the typical incidence in liveborn babies.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 5-7% is still above the usual approximate incidence in liveborn babies.

source.hint: This value represents the baseline occurrence rate for major anomalies in newborns.
